process.trigger: New chat/model/computer or material dependency/blocker change.
inputs: Live master and exact scoped task; current contracts.
Existing authorized clean worktree/status/diff and current writer evidence.
Current source/artifact/receipt identities and scoped roadmap node.
steps: Read current AGENTS/operating/domain contracts; check live base and writer overlap.
Check catalog plus do-not-repeat; reuse exact artifacts and affected roadmap nodes.
Pin latest compatible playbook, dependencies, scope, authority and proof in one packet.
Reconcile only affected state; retain UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN and historical exact-SHA evidence.
Return one linked receipt/handoff and release the scoped lane; never invoke specialists.
stop_condition: Base/dependency conflict or unknown live HEAD.
No existing authorized writable clean worktree for implementation.
Overlapping writer, absent scoped authority or failed readback.

checks: Live master equals the independently supplied expected base.
Worktree status/diff/permission and writer evidence are recorded.
Packet SHA binds current playbook ID/version/hash and all scope fields.
Required dependency bytes match externally pinned SHA256.
Catalog lookup rejects superseded entries and records blocked research reuse.
Handoff distinguishes GitHub/Drive/local evidence and NOT_RUN; no completed_tasks mutation.

steps: Bind exact input/code/proof evidence and classify the failure.
Look up the canonical reuse catalog and do-not-repeat registry.
Propose the smallest C2 manual/tool/test correction; record version and supersedes.
Run affected proof; independent review before adoption. C3 retains existing approval gates.

process.trigger: Required source generation changed, expired, corrected or unavailable.
inputs: Exact retained raw/generation/catalog/execution/quality identities and declared scope.
steps: Verify source identity/availability/hash/license and required population without recollection.
Use the existing frozen Reader/Lake; bind all consumed sources and record blocked optional sources.
Check missing/stale/future/conflict/synthetic/lifecycle/corporate-action/calendar/PIT boundaries.
Prepare immutable-generation/admission evidence and readback proof; no pointer write by this manual.
Return scoped eligible/blocked evidence to A0; actual collection/admission publication requires separate domain authorization.
stop_condition: Missing, stale, future, synthetic, conflicting or unlicensed required source.
Unknown required universe/lifecycle/calendar identity or writer conflict.
No verified immutable readback or absent separate publication authority.

checks: Actual source/raw/catalog/receipt SHA256 and immutable generation match.
Availability and collection clocks are causal and decision-eligible.
Required population/denominator/lifecycle/calendar and missingness are explicit.
Readback validates required bytes; catalog/hash alone is not economic readiness.
Reader performs no provider refresh, silent latest or fallback.
Engineering/PARTIAL evidence never certifies whole-universe G0/ER/A5 or writes an accepted pointer.

steps: Bind exact input/code/proof evidence and classify the failure.
Look up the canonical reuse catalog and do-not-repeat registry.
Propose the smallest C2 manual/tool/test correction; record version and supersedes.
Run affected proof; independent review before adoption. C3 retains existing approval gates.

process.trigger: One exact implementation head or corrected artifact is ready for independent review.
inputs: Exact review HEAD/base/diff, required checks and current threads.
Pinned task/playbook/dependencies, actual output bytes and claimed proof.
Independent reviewer identity and scoped counterexamples.
steps: Confirm reviewer is separate from authors; pin exact HEAD and actual diff/dependencies.
Read current contracts and reproduce reachable boundary counterexamples read-only.
Verify output/raw hashes, causal clocks and claim completeness; preserve historical test identity.
Check focused normal/-O where applicable and new exact-head required CI; list NOT_RUN.
Return CLEAN/CORRECTION_REQUIRED/STALE_INPUT scoped findings to A0; no fixes, dispatch, merge or approval escalation.
stop_condition: Review HEAD/base/dependency moves or required evidence cannot be read.
Reviewer is an implementation author or observed mutation is needed.
Missing current-head CI/output binding or unresolved reachable finding.

checks: Reviewer identity is independent of implementation authors.
Live HEAD/base/diff match the pinned review bundle; changed head is STALE_INPUT.
Applicable positive/negative/adversarial fixtures are executed and falsifiable.
Actual output hashes and availability bind to causal dependencies.
Normal/-O and all current required CI apply to this head; old PASS is historical.
Findings/NOT_RUN are explicit and do not grant source/economic/target/broker authority.

steps: Bind exact input/code/proof evidence and classify the failure.
Look up the canonical reuse catalog and do-not-repeat registry.
Propose the smallest C2 manual/tool/test correction; record version and supersedes.
Run affected proof; independent review before adoption. C3 retains existing approval gates.
